title: Execution Report Contract
purpose: Defines the atomic execution report output artifact format for the initializer.

normative_requirements.text: An execution report shall be an atomic output artifact that records the outcome of each lifecycle stage, any warnings or errors produced, and the overall completion status.

The execution report shall distinguish completed stages from skipped, deferred, or failed stages, and shall not report overall success when any required stage failed or was skipped without explicit authority.
The execution report contract shall declare a machine-readable representation and the fields required by that representation.
